verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: logo, then headline with subcopy, then can, then CTA. Its flaws are the NEW FLAVOR pill jammed against the top edge and overlapping the circle, a headline so small that the CTA outweighs it, and a dead gap between the subcopy and the can. B makes the headline strong but crushes the subcopy into a tiny 5-line column ending in the orphan 'hour.', which is illegible and sits on the circle. B also shrinks the logo to near-invisibility and leads with the badge, which muddles the hierarchy.
